ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Logging Disabled Via Registry Key Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the registry for the currently logged-in user. In order to disable PowerShell module logging, script block logging or transcription and script execution logging Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PowerShell\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\PowerShellCore\\\\.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\ModuleLogging\\\\EnableModuleLogging$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\ScriptBlockLogging\\\\EnableScriptBlockLogging$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\ScriptBlockLogging\\\\EnableScriptBlockInvocationLogging$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Transcription\\\\EnableTranscripting$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Transcription\\\\EnableInvocationHeader$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\EnableScripts$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")
